profile.name: 回环通信器
profile.description: 一种用于仪器通信测试的虚拟回环通信接口，通过标准输入/输出模拟原始数据读写。在未连接实际仪器时，可用于单元测试、接口探索以及开发调试。
profile.description_en: A virtual loopback communication interface for instrument communication testing. It simulates raw data read/write through standard input and output, and is used for unit testing, API exploration, and development debugging when no physical instrument is connected.

registry.name: Loopback Communicator
registry.description: Loopback Communicator驱动，支持address/close/flush input/read raw/seek等9个操作。
